criterion: objective = L1 + w_ee*(1-EE) on the prepared frame, the teacher's own function; L1/NCC only for comparisons. EE/peak_ratio excluded: the flat spot is a delta inside the support, so its EE is ~1 by construction and peak_ratio is scale-mixed.
notes: pred_rms_zero / teacher_rms_zero are modulo-2*pi amplitudes (atan2 output in [-pi,pi]). rms_vs_teacher_rad / mae_vs_teacher_rad are the masked wrapped difference to the teacher after removing the unobservable global piston, in radians. dist_* are masked mean |exp(i a) - exp(i b)|. dist_ratio = dist(pred,teacher)/dist(teacher,flat): ~1 means the net sits as far from the teacher as flat does (near-zero phase), ~0 means it agrees with the teacher. sup_l1 is the trainer's supervised leg (piston_free_phasor_l1) recomputed here; it must match history.csv's train_sup for the same weights.
